message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse the prompt. The user says: "You are agent B. Choose exactly one task for yourself. ... Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}."

But also says: "You are an ORIGINAL agent before replacement. Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T4","B":"T3"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents."

Thus they want us to output JSON with B's assigned task. According to assignment, B gets T3. So we output {"task":"T3","reason":"assigned by joint allocation"}.

We must ensure only JSON, no extra text.
